intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both sit in {{cityA}}, and this page compares their recorded {{course}} fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.
MIT WPU vs Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce is not a single winner. Compare fees, admission tests and the BA classroom each campus offers.

sections.heading: MIT WPU vs Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce for BA: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose MIT WPU if you want a 2022 flagship package record of ₹44 LPA, and a recorded fee of ₹60,000, in a private BA setting at Pune.
Choose Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce if you want a 2023 flagship package record of ₹5 LPA, in a private BA setting at Pune.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip short, executive or certificate rows when the picker can tell them apart. Always match the fee to the exact programme you will join.
Our records show ₹60,000 as a programme total for Bachelor of Arts (Hons) English at MIT WPU.
We do not hold a quotable programme total for Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce that clears the fee floor on this page, so do not budget from a raw minimum row.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: MIT WPU's latest recorded flagship year here is 2022, with a highest package of ₹44 LPA on B.A Media & Communication. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce's latest recorded flagship year here is 2023, with an average of ₹5 LPA and a highest package of ₹22 LPA on B.A English. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2022 and 2023, so the packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
If you are comparing offers, use the latest official placement report from each institute and match the programme name, not an executive or certificate batch.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for MIT WPU on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Our records do not list a confirmed entrance exam for Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce on this page. Use the institute's current admission notice rather than last year's cut-off stories.
Eligibility wording can change by cycle. Use the current official admission brochure rather than last year's cut-off stories.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in {{cityA}}, Maharashtra. If you want to stay in this city, the choice is less about relocation and more about the classroom, fees and the admission route.
Visit both campuses if you can, or at least read each official hostel and location note, before you treat travel time or hostel cost as a given.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: MIT WPU is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded BA offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce is the better fit if its city, admission test and recorded BA offering match what you want, and if you have confirmed the latest official notice.
If fees are the only filter, do not use the lowest number in our raw rows. Check each official fee notice for the exact programme and batch you will join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, MIT WPU or Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce?
faqs.answer: It depends on the programme you want. MIT WPU and Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce differ in more than one way: the useful differences are fees, the admission test and the kind of BA classroom each campus offers.

faqs.question: What are the recorded fees for MIT WPU vs Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce?
faqs.answer: our records list ₹60,000 for MIT WPU on Bachelor of Arts (Hons) English; we do not hold a quotable fee for Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce on this page. Confirm both official notices before you decide.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for MIT WPU and Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce?
faqs.answer: MIT WPU's latest recorded flagship year here is 2022, with a highest package of ₹44 LPA on B.A Media & Communication. These are historical batch figures, not a salary promise.

faqs.question: Which entrance exams do MIT WPU and Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce accept?
faqs.answer: Our records list no listed exam on this page for MIT WPU, and no listed exam on this page for Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce. Always confirm the current admission brochure, because tests and cut-offs change by year.

faqs.question: Are MIT WPU and Symbiosis College of Arts and Commerce in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Pune, Maharashtra. The move is about the programme, fees and tests, not a change of city.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year and by programme. Verify the current official fee notice, admission brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
